cover_headline: US Visa Curbs Push Indian IT Firms Toward Offshore Hiring, Analysts Say
facts: The US Labor Department suspended eight employers from PERM, the first step in employer-sponsored green cards, on October 8
H-1B petitions for workers outside the US without a valid H-1B visa must be accompanied by a $100,000 payment
The top seven Indian IT firms won just 4,573 new H-1B approvals in fiscal 2025, 37 percent fewer than the year before

end.headline: US Visa Curbs Push Indian IT Firms Toward Offshore Hiring, Analysts Say
end.line: Analysts say the industry's response is to move the job to India rather than the worker to America.
